bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears are reportedly maintaining ongoing trade discussions with the Los Angeles Chargers about acquiring edge rusher Khalil Mack ahead of the November 10 trade deadline, as the 5-2 Bears look to bolster their roster. This interest comes after Chicago lost tight end Cole Kmet for the season to a knee injury, a move that followed the team's statement 30-24 win over the previously unbeaten Patriots on Thursday Night Football.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions defeated the Green Bay Packers 20-17 on a last-play field goal from Jake Bates, with Dan Campbell's aggressive fourth-down gamble failing before the defense and special teams bailed him out. Dan Campbell's latest gamble did not pan out and the Detroit Lions made plays in all three phases — with some yellow flags that went their way — to bail out the aggressive coach.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers fell to 4-3 after a controversial 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions, with a disputed late hit penalty on Packers defensive tackle Devonte Wyatt shifting momentum in Detroit's victory . The setback was compounded by injuries, as Green Bay lost both starting and backup centers, Sean Rhyan and Jacob Monk, creating an issue along the offensive line with a short week incoming .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Vikings improved to 6-0 and are now the NFL's last unbeaten team after a 16-10 win over the Indianapolis Colts, highlighted by Harrison Smith securing the victory with his 40th career interception . The win came with a scare, however, as running back Aaron Jones suffered a knee injury, though reports indicate he avoided a serious injury and is considered day-to-day .
